searchText: Does this PR being merged signal that the TTD/Bellatrix epoch is "final"? I.e., is it time to cut releases? (cc <@552133098075193354> <@291925846556540928>) https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2969 I would wait until after ACD to cut releases just in case but probably OK to merge a PR with it in the codebase? Got it, thank you! 🙏 We'll also need new spec tests, I think certain spec tests that use mainnet ttd will fail without an update There was one ref test that failed from memory. I updated our test harness to override the TTD back to the placeholder value, but definitely would be good to have the ref tests check the actual value is right. <dannyryan> was planning on doing an rc release tomorrow with all tests (a few new) <dannyryan> can scan to make sure we have actual TTD baked on a few mainnet tests the lodestar node propagating gossip message has no connected validator, and the message is `beacon_aggregate_and_proof` which is a core topic for all nodes to subscribe too, lodestar did not attest to that bad block. there was an issue of js-gossipsub gossiping not validated messages, and that's the root cause of the issue, we will make a hot fix for that soon. Thanks <@476250636548308992> for this! Great, glad to see that fixed

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content: I would wait until after ACD to cut releases just in case but probably OK to merge a PR with it in the codebase?

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content: We'll also need new spec tests, I think certain spec tests that use mainnet ttd will fail without an update

excerpts.author: ajsutton
excerpts.content: There was one ref test that failed from memory. I updated our test harness to override the TTD back to the placeholder value, but definitely would be good to have the ref tests check the actual value is right.

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <dannyryan> was planning on doing an rc release tomorrow with all tests (a few new)

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <dannyryan> can scan to make sure we have actual TTD baked on a few mainnet tests

excerpts.author: tuyen4818
excerpts.content:
the lodestar node propagating gossip message has no connected validator, and the message is `beacon_aggregate_and_proof` which is a core topic for all nodes to subscribe too, lodestar did not attest to that bad block.

there was an issue of js-gossipsub gossiping not validated messages, and that's the root cause of the issue, we will make a hot fix for that soon. Thanks <@476250636548308992> for this!

excerpts.content: Great, glad to see that fixed
